summary: Chilwa Minerals Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing two Australian Securities Exchange announcements: a drilling update on the Mpyupyu West heavy mineral sands prospect and the company's annual financial report for the year ended 30 June 2026. The drilling update reports 218 holes for 2,292 metres, roughly 80% of a planned 272-hole Phase I programme, with mineralisation averaging 8 metres depth. There are no transaction terms, no board recommendation, no advisors and no deal mechanics. This is a routine operational and financial reporting filing, not a special situation; monitor assay results due late October and any maiden JORC Exploration Target.
